Contains beat-annotated transcripts of ~30 winning 1-4 minute VSLs (Farmer's Dog, Ryze Mushroom Coffee, Nebroo Hearing Aids, Apex Labs, etc.), longer VSL scripts, advertorial formulas, and reference ad URL lists. Serves as the raw reference behind the annotated swipe-file .md files.
